source_text: Quid est hoc: Amplius non dicetur, cum hoc usque hodie tantis Manichaeorum conatibus asseratur? Sed hoc est quod indicat, quoniam nemo, qui est de populo Israel vel qui huius Scripturae auctoritatem suscipit, post definitionem meam tale quid audebit accredere. Porro omnis, qui in illa opinione perstiterit nec his oboedit litteris, nec in eo, qui est verus Israel, enumerabitur.
pass_a_gloss: What is this: It will no longer be said, when up to today this is asserted by such great attempts of the Manichaeans? But this is what it indicates, since no one who is of the people of Israel or who takes up the authority of this Scripture will dare after my definition to believe such a thing. Further, everyone who has persisted in that opinion neither obeys these letters nor will be enumerated in that which is the true Israel.

lemmas.lexica: Blaise Manichaeus; Julian's polemic label vs natural evil

pass_b_english: What does ‘It shall no longer be spoken’ mean, when the Manichaeans still maintain it today with such effort? It means this: no one belonging to the people of Israel, or accepting this Scripture’s authority, will dare believe such a thing after my ruling. Anyone who persists in that opinion neither obeys these writings nor will be counted among the true Israel.

choices.why: Julian's standing charge: natural evil is Manichaean. Keep the sect-name, not 'dualists'.
Julian's sacred writings; keep Scripture, not 'Bible' as a later book-name.

anf_compare.notes: Victorian English of some of Julian survives inside NPNF Augustine (chiefly On Marriage and Concupiscence and related anti-Pelagian books). NPNF was not copied. Pass A is a literal gloss of Augustinus.it Latin of Julian's words only; Augustine's replies in the same locus are excluded.

bible_refs.note: Repeats the words that the proverb will no longer be spoken.
The distinction between Israel and true Israel may echo Paul’s distinction.

speaker: Julian of Eclanum (words preserved in Augustine, Opus imperfectum contra Iulianum); Augustine's reply at this locus is excluded.
